role.title: Cloud Security Engineer
role.focus: Security architecture and controls for cloud identity, networking, workloads, data and DevSecOps
role.objective: Build, ship, test and maintain reliable production-grade systems in this specialization.

responsibilities.1: Design and implement security architecture and controls for cloud identity, networking, workloads, data and devsecops.
responsibilities.2: Translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
responsibilities.3: Write clean, modular and testable code.
responsibilities.4: Work with databases, APIs and production infrastructure relevant to the role.
responsibilities.5: Debug failures using logs, metrics and systematic root-cause analysis.
responsibilities.6: Use Git and collaborative development practices.
responsibilities.7: Automate repetitive engineering and deployment workflows.
responsibilities.8: Apply security, reliability and performance best practices.
responsibilities.9: Document architecture, decisions and operational procedures.
responsibilities.10: Deploy solutions and monitor them in realistic environments.
responsibilities.11: Measure quality and improve systems based on evidence.
responsibilities.12: Collaborate with engineers, product stakeholders and data teams.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical engineering work.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with documented technical decisions and a deployed or reproducible implementation.

interview_questions.6: How do you design IAM safely?
interview_questions.9: How do you segment cloud networks?
interview_questions.13: How do you secure object storage?
interview_questions.23: What is a cloud security posture?
interview_questions.31: How do you secure Terraform state?
interview_questions.32: How do you prevent credential leakage?
interview_questions.33: How do you detect public storage exposure?
interview_questions.34: How do you handle cloud misconfiguration?
interview_questions.40: How do you investigate cloud audit logs?
interview_questions.41: How do you respond to compromised credentials?
interview_questions.42: How do you implement centralized security monitoring?
interview_questions.43: How would you design a secure cloud landing zone?
interview_questions.44: How would you secure a public API?
interview_questions.45: How would you secure a data lake?
interview_questions.47: How do you automate security remediation?
interview_questions.48: How do you balance developer velocity and security?
interview_questions.49: Design a secure multi-tier cloud architecture.

1.name: Secure Cloud Landing Zone
1.description: Design cloud accounts/projects, IAM boundaries, network segmentation, centralized logging, encryption, guardrails and automated compliance checks.

2.name: DevSecOps Pipeline
2.description: Create a CI/CD pipeline that performs dependency, secret, IaC, SAST and container scans before deployment, with policy gates.

3.name: Cloud Detection and Response Platform
3.description: Collect cloud audit events, create detection rules for suspicious access, enrich alerts and automate safe remediation actions.
